# M13 The Free Port (province: the Free Port of Mercato on the Bay of Salt): capture the Harbour Office (neutral city, centre) and hold it 3 days. Everyone fights everyone. Quarters: Kindle's Black Hole dock in the north (bay, Black Factory, crystals, minicannons), Javier's Green Earth west quarter on the sea, Sonja's Yellow Comet east quarter on the sea, the player's south quarter on the south bay; two winding rivers (Rio Sale west, Rio Dolce east) cut the quarters from the central square, crossed by bridges. Start forces: player INF4 MECH2 TANK3 MDT2 RECON2 ART2 AA1 APC1 (17); Javier and Sonja each INF3 MECH1 TANK3 MDT1 RECON1 ART1 AA1 (11); Kindle the same + FTR1 BCO1 (13). Threat/answer: tanks and Md Tanks -> own Tanks/MDT/ARTs behind the rivers; Kindle's Fighter and Copter -> AA on the line + the bases; minicannons (17,8) (21,8) cover the north road to the square only: go round by the ridge gates or take them with ART; ART -> Recon to see, tanks to close; Landers/ships (ports on the north bay, the south bay and both sea coasts) -> Tanks/ART on the quay.
